title: Hearty French Lamb Tartiflette Cassoulet
description: A rich, flavorful French dish inspired by the cuisine of Lyon, perfect for a special date night. This cassoulet combines the tender sweetness of lamb with the savory depth of onions, garlic, and mushrooms.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 2-inch pieces
ingredients.notes: Choose a grass-fed lamb for a more robust flavor

instructions: In a large Dutch oven, combine the lamb, onions, garlic, and mushrooms, and cook over medium heat until the lamb is browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the soffritto base to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the white wine to the pot and cook until the liquid is almost completely reduced, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, and thyme to the pot, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the cassoulet for 25 minutes, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
While the cassoulet is baking, prepare the tartiflette topping by grating the potatoes and separating them into individual layers.
When the cassoulet is done, remove it from the oven and top it with the tartiflette topping, arranging the potatoes in a single layer on top of the lamb.
Return the pot to the oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
To serve, transfer the cassoulet to a large platter or individual plates and spoon the tartiflette topping over the top of each serving.
Garnish with fresh thyme and serve immediately.
